page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a high-capacity general-purpose cloud instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, the instance features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory. This yields a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU, matching typical general-purpose enterprise computing specifications.

The instance offers a high network bandwidth baseline of 33 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers across cluster environments and network-attached storage solutions. Local NVMe or SSD storage is absent on the instance itself, requiring reliance on remote block storage systems for persistent data. Hardware accelerators such as GPUs are not included in this configuration.

Given its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and 33 Gbps network capabilities, ecs.g5ne.18xlarge provides dense compute resource allocation without storage overhead. This configuration offers solid cost efficiency for large-scale distributed workloads, corporate enterprise applications, microservice platforms, middle-tier web servers, and network-bound processing pipelines that do not depend on local ephemeral storage.
